slides.headline: He was born and educated in India. Now he runs one of the world's biggest beer companies.
Rahul Goyal became President and CEO of Molson Coors Beverage Company, one of the world's largest brewers.
slides.body: Born and educated in India, Goyal earned a mechanical engineering degree from Mysore University before moving to the United States to build his career, eventually rising to lead a company that owns brands like Coors, Miller, and Blue Moon.

slides.headline: Decades of operations and leadership roles across major global companies led to the top job.
slides.body: His appointment put him at the helm of one of the largest beverage companies on earth - built on an engineering foundation he started in an Indian classroom.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A Viksit Bharat benefits every time an Indian engineering education becomes the foundation for leading a global company.
slides.body: Goyal's path - an Indian university degree to the top of a multinational brewer - is one more data point in how far that foundation can carry someone.
